title: BUG22 db_patterns oracle playbook
description: Generic oracle-aligned checklist for database pattern tasks: transactional safety, session lifecycle, and query efficiency.
code:
# DB patterns oracle playbook

Required outcomes:
- Commit only after successful unit of work.
- Rollback on exceptions before re-raising.
- Always close session resources.
- Avoid N+1 query patterns when loading related entities.

Failure modes to avoid:
- Commit in finally regardless of errors.
- Missing rollback path on exceptions.
- Leaking sessions/connections.
- Repeating per-row DB fetches when batch fetch is available.
